categories.main_business_segments: Donaldson Company operates through three primary business segments: Mobile Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Life Sciences. Mobile Solutions (63.4% of net sales) includes Off-Road, On-Road, and Aftermarket units focused on filtration for vehicles and equipment. Industrial Solutions (29.6% of net sales) covers Industrial Air Filtration, Industrial Gasses, Industrial Hydraulics, Power Generation, and Aerospace and Defense. Life Sciences (7.0% of net sales) serves bioprocessing, food and beverage, medical device, vehicle electrification, microelectronics, and disk drive markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Donaldson leverages advanced filtration technologies such as PowerCore®, Ultra-Web®, and Synteq® XP for air, fuel, lube, and hydraulic filtration. The company integrates Internet-of-Things (IoT) solutions like iCue™ for connected services and performance monitoring. Manufacturing is global, with over 75 facilities, and includes proprietary membrane and chromatography technologies for bioprocessing, as well as custom-engineered filtration systems for industrial and life sciences applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in construction, mining, agriculture, transportation, aerospace, and defense, as well as independent distributors, OEM dealer networks, and direct end users. Major end markets span industrial manufacturing, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, power generation, electronics, and bioprocessing. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of net sales, reflecting a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: Donaldson operates globally with significant revenue contributions from the U.S. and Canada (42.7%), EMEA (29.4%), Asia Pacific (17.7%), and Latin America (10.2%). The company maintains over 150 locations, including 75 manufacturing and distribution centers, across six continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Donaldson primarily operates as a midstream and downstream supplier, providing filtration components, systems, and aftermarket parts to OEMs, distributors, and end users. The company sources raw materials such as steel, filter media, and petrochemical products from third-party suppliers and adds value through design, manufacturing, and service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include extending market access (notably in bioprocessing and alternative power solutions), expanding technologies and solutions (such as connected services and digital integration), and pursuing strategic acquisitions in high-margin areas. R&D focuses on material science, new filtration media, digital/IoT integration, and disruptive bioprocessing technologies, with $78.1 million spent in FY2023 (2.3% of net sales).
categories.revenue_model: Donaldson generates revenue primarily through the sale of filtration products, systems, and aftermarket replacement parts. Additional revenue streams include service contracts, connected digital solutions, and, in Life Sciences, consumables and specialized equipment. The company is transitioning some offerings from subscription to service models to capture more aftermarket share.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Donaldson faces competition from large global and regional filtration companies across all segments. It is considered a market leader in Off-Road and On-Road OEM filtration and in the Aftermarket business. Industrial and Life Sciences segments compete with both large multinationals and niche players, with competition based on technology, innovation, price, service, and geographic reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2023, Donaldson reported net sales of $3.43 billion, up 3.8% from the prior year, with net earnings of $358.8 million (10.5% net margin). The company has demonstrated steady growth, with a diversified revenue base and strong cash flow from operations ($544.5 million in FY2023). The balance sheet is robust, with $1.32 billion in equity and a debt-to-capitalization ratio of 33.2%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Donaldson emphasizes technology-led, high-performance filtration solutions that meet stringent reliability and efficiency requirements. Its value proposition centers on innovation, proprietary filtration media, global reach, and the ability to solve complex customer challenges across diverse industries. The company differentiates through advanced materials, digital integration, and a broad aftermarket offering, supporting customer productivity, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
